title: FlashBridge kernel mediator and soft-fallback rollout plan for v2/v3 attention parity
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Introduce a lightweight mediation layer (FlashBridge) that harmonizes FlashAttention v2 and v3 kernel choices at runtime to reduce regressions during mixed rollouts. FlashBridge aims to: 1) select compatible kernels by workload fingerprint, 2) prioritize stable v2 paths for high-risk traffic while experimenting on v3 in controlled slices, and 3) implement a "soft-fallback" path that heals 95th/99th percentile latency regressions without full rollback. This ticket covers the design, implementation hooks in the scheduler, canary plan, and testbench to validate parity and safety metrics.
proposed_solution: Add a kernel mediator layer in the runtime that sits between the workload fingerprinting and kernel sequencer. FlashBridge will: (a) compute a lightweight runtime fingerprint (sequence length distribution, head/kv size, quantization profile), (b) consult a small decision table with safety thresholds (memory headroom, warmup success rate), (c) attempt preferred v3 kernel for low-risk slices, but keep a preallocated v2 safe path for immediate soft-fallback. The mediator exposes telemetry hooks for per-request decisions and emits explainability tags (chosen_kernel, decision_reason, fallback_count). Implement a rolling canary that starts at 0.5% traffic and advances using automated quality gates (latency, OOMs, correctness diffs on eval prompts).
acceptance_criteria: FlashBridge toggled on in dev runtime with decision logging enabled
Canary automation advances from 0.5% to 20% traffic when gates pass
Soft-fallback triggers within 200ms of detecting a 95th percentile latency delta > 15% for a kernel variant
No increase in OOM incidence above baseline during canary (<= +0.5% relative)
End-to-end correctness diffs (on 10k eval prompts) below 0.7% for token-accuracy-sensitive models
milestones: Design doc and decision table v0 — 2026-02-28
comments: 2026-02-25 Maya Thompson: Spoke with infra and research — v3 gives 10-18% mean token throughput improvements on clean traces, but we've seen tail regressions when workspace fragmentation occurs. Proposed mediator to avoid all-or-nothing rollouts.

2026-02-27 Diego Alvarez: Prototype of decision table added to runtime-config repo. Decision table includes sequence_len_bin, kv_cache_pressure, quantized_flag. Pushing instrumentation to emit decision tags for offline analysis.

2026-03-01 Priya Banerjee (research): Ran 5k eval prompts; v3 mismatch rate is ~0.9% on quantized 4-bit models for edge-case prompts — flagged for tolerance thresholds. Suggest we gate on model-quantization combos.
2026-03-03 Ops: Observability hooks accepted; added alerts for fallback_rate > 2% in a minute window. Ensure canary rules lower threshold for early detection.

2026-03-05 Diego Alvarez: Implemented soft-fallback path. Fallback implementation uses fast-path switch (no full request retry) to v2 kernel when condition matched. Need performance test to verify <200ms reaction and no token duplication.
2026-03-05 QA: Creating regression suite: (1) 10k generation traces, (2) long-context streaming with repeated prefill, (3) stress OOM fuzzing across 4 GPU types. Will attach results to PR.
